observations: The page number «96» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. The page has no signature. L01 completes the sentence that ends p. 95 (JP2 0127, L36), «stattgefunden, also nach».

L01-L04. Checked: 12h − 3h 40m = 8h 20m in the morning of 23 January; Antioch lies about 36° 10′ east and Cordova 4° 47′ west of Greenwich, some 41° apart, 2h 44m of time; 5h 11m + 2h 44m = 7h 55m; 8h 20m − 7h 55m = 25m. The 5h 11m include the parallax in time computed for Cordova, 1h 33½m (p. 95, JP2 0127, L19); that for Antioch is not computed.
L04-L06. Checked against Nallino I, 56: at Antioch «occultatus est Sol, secundum visum, paulo magis quam dimidia parte», and at ar-Raqqah «Solis minus quam 2/3 occultatae sunt, secundum visum».

L07-L22. Checked against the Latin of chapter 34 (p. 28, JP2 0060, L21-L24): «Si enim fuerit luna inter horoscopum et medium caelum, erit hoc productum horis coniunctionis addendum ; … Quodque inde surget, horam eclipsis supra locum pro quo inquiris ex diversitate aspectus mutatam ponit.»; and of chapter 35 (p. 29, JP2 0061, L20): «Si enim fuerit locus coniunctionis inter horoscopum et medium caelum». N01: al-Battānī (Nallino I, 83-84) calls the place so found «locus eclipticae in quo Luna apparet», the apparent place of Suter's emendation.

L23-L24: the heading of chapters 32 and 36, in bold, centred, with the reference to the text below it in smaller type. Checked: chapter 32 stands on p. 25 of the text (JP2 0057), chapter 36 on pp. 29-30 (JP2 0061-0062). N02: p. 86 (JP2 0118), note 3: chapter 32 stands at this place only in Ms. C, in N on fol. 56r.

L30-L31. Checked against the Latin: the heading of chapter 32 (p. 25, JP2 0057) has «dispositionis casarum XII» and «Quam dispositionem dicunt tezwiet elbuiut», «tezwiet» the Arabic «taswiya»; chapter 36 (p. 29, JP2 0061) is headed «De aequatione XII domorum». L33-L35 and N03: Nallino's note «Supputatio duodecim domorum astrologicarum» (I, 246-249) says that the astrologers divide the sky in different ways, but all by six great circles which cut one another in two opposite points.

L29: a small raised dot after «Ekliptik,», and L07 a faint mark after «haben,» and L06 before «unserer»; not transcribed. L36: «Ptolemäische» spaced, an adjective; L37 «Kh.» spaced (9 px between the K and the h).
The dashes: L24 «29—30», «79—90» (33-35 px, the smaller type), N01 «83—84» (36 px), N03 «246—249» (44 px): long dashes, set close.

Spaced type, marked {sp:}: «Batt.», «Athelhard», «Ptolemäische», «Kh.», «Nallino»; italics: «Antiochia», «Cordova,», «Raḳḳa» (with a dot under each k), the Latin of L13-L20, «Parallaxe», «astrologischen» (L26), «taswiya», «aequatio,», «dispositio», «Quadripartitum». L13 «Kap. 34 (p. 28)»: the page of the text.
The colons and semicolons stand after the thin space of the edition (8-13 px measured).
